name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a Forest that lets Birds of Paradise be cast. Green Sun's Zenith never unlocks anything here despite also needing only green: it is an X spell, and the api's hypothetical_facts excludes an X-cost card from unlocks entirely (commit 5749f9a, 'an X-cost card payable only at X=0 never counts as unlocked') - castability at the cheapest legal X is not treated as a meaningful unlock, confirmed empirically against the committed fixture (devoted_forest_gsz_x0_probe). This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first. Prefers a basic Forest first, never a scarce fetch target; the spec's own second tier, a horizon land paying 1 life for its own colored mana (Nurturing Peatland's 'Pay 1 life: Add'), is restored right after it - the sibling engine's own e1-land-helpers fix (magic-cards-model commit d8c0611) makes payability count a {T}+pay-life mana ability, and the api now surfaces it (hypothetical_facts commit 2b61382), so Peatland's own unlocks reads true, confirmed empirically (devoted_nurturing_peatland_unlocks_birds, devoted_peatland_mortuary_birds_t1). Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this.
